items.t: Supercharger oil seal leak and blue smoke
items.job: Replace supercharger with rebuilt unit, flush intercooler piping
items.note: Owners report about $2,400 for a rebuilt unit (less core credit) and dealer quotes up to $7,000. Used units are cheap but risky.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping, stuck in gear or HOLD light flashing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with used or rebuilt unit
items.note: First have codes read: a sensor or solenoid fault costs far less. An owner reported a $7,000 quote for a new transmission.

items.t: Valve cover gasket leak causing misfires
items.job: Replace both valve cover gaskets and plug tube seals
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $690-$861. Oil-soaked spark plugs or boots add to the cost.

items.t: EGR valve failure with shaking and check engine light
items.job: Replace EGR valve
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $672-$878; one owner paid nearly $1,000 because the valve is at the back of the engine.

items.t: Oxygen sensor failure and check engine light
items.job: Replace upstream oxygen sensor
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $502-$1,360. Rear-bank sensors on the V6 are harder to reach.

items.t: Knock sensor code P0325 turns on check engine light
items.job: Replace knock sensor (under intake manifold)
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $653-$941. Check wiring and the Mazda bulletin first.

items.t: Misfire codes P0300-P0306 and rough running
items.job: Replace spark plugs and ignition wires, clean plug wells
items.note: Cost rises if a valve cover gasket leak is the cause.

items.t: Water pump coolant leak
items.job: Replace water pump with timing belt and tensioner
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $889-$1,112. Doing the timing belt at the same time saves repeat labor.

items.t: Clunking or knocking from the front suspension
items.job: Replace front stabilizer links and bushings
items.note: Worn struts cost more; RepairPal estimates about $1,029-$1,211 for a strut replacement.

items.t: Creak or squeak from the rear suspension
items.job: Service or replace rear suspension bushings

items.t: TCS and TCS OFF lights on with ABS codes 83/84
items.job: Diagnose ABS/TCS fault and repair wiring or sensor
items.note: A failed ABS/TCS control module would cost more.

items.t: Whining or ringing noise inside the car
items.job: Apply Mazda bulletin fix (cable/insulator)

items.t: Musty or mildew smell from the A/C vents
items.job: Clean A/C evaporator and treat for odor

items.t: Water leaking under the passenger side of the dash
items.job: Clear A/C drain and reseal cooling unit

items.t: Blower motor noisy, wrong speed or not working
items.job: Replace blower motor or resistor and clean housing

items.t: Windshield wipers stop working
items.job: Replace wiper motor

items.t: Highway speed surge on S models
items.job: Apply bulletin fix and check vacuum lines

items.t: Squealing or rubbing noise from the drive belt
items.job: Replace drive belt and tensioner

items.t: Airbag warning light on with codes 26 or 37
items.job: Diagnose SRS fault; replace clock spring if faulty
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $361-$407 for a clock spring replacement.

items.t: Evaporative system code P1455 turns on check engine light
items.job: Smoke-test vapor system; replace gas cap or vent part

items.t: Rattling noise from the exhaust system
items.job: Secure or replace heat shields and hangers

items.t: Tilt steering wheel stuck or not working
items.job: Repair tilt motor or switch
items.note: Used tilt motors are often the cheapest fix.
